changelog:
Initial release — provides a brand-neutral, expert consultation to help users choose a standing desk based on their needs.

- Guides users through key questions about height, equipment load, workspace, and environment to determine required desk specs.
- Recommends specifications for height range, weight capacity, frame type, motor type, surface size, and stability.
- Avoids sales bias and specific brand recommendations; empowers users to evaluate any standing desk independently.
- Ensures regional safety, power compatibility, and ergonomic requirements are addressed.
- Designed for first-time buyers, upgraders, and those seeking unbiased, structured advice.
